stored logs: outage warnings are stored in Loki, correlated to their trace, metrics stored, no secrets

anonymous: the dashboard redirects to sign-in and status data is refused
register: field errors, then a new synthetic account lands on the protected dashboard

lockout: five failures lock the account; every failure reads exactly like an unknown email

boundary: no external identity provider is offered, configured or reachable
